aftrhrs.storage.title: Storage Network
aftrhrs.storage.view-craft-tip: Quick Craft: everything you can make from this storage and your inventory, and how many
aftrhrs.storage.show-craftable: Show: Craftable. Click to show every recipe, with what is missing
aftrhrs.storage.show-all: Show: All Recipes (what you can make first). Click to show only what you can make
aftrhrs.storage.auto-on: Auto-Craft: On. Missing ingredients that can be crafted from what you have are crafted first (up to %s steps deep). Click to turn off
aftrhrs.storage.auto-off: Auto-Craft: Off. Only recipes whose ingredients are all there already. Click to turn on
aftrhrs.storage.amount: Craft amount: a left-click crafts ×%s (left: more, right: less)
aftrhrs.storage.jei-on: JEI sync: On. This search and JEI's search follow each other. Click to turn off
aftrhrs.storage.jei-off: JEI sync: Off. Click to keep this search and JEI's search in step
aftrhrs.storage.options: Search options: what the search box does when a terminal opens
aftrhrs.storage.opt-open-tip-jei: The search box opens with whatever JEI is searching for. Click to change (right-click: back)
aftrhrs.storage.opt-open-tip-clear: The search box opens empty every time (with JEI sync on, JEI's search is cleared too). Click to change (right-click: back)
aftrhrs.storage.opt-open-tip-keep: The search box opens with the last search you typed in a terminal. Click to change (right-click: back)
aftrhrs.storage.opt-focus-tip: When on, the search box is already selected as a terminal opens, so you can start typing at once (Esc still closes; E types an e)
aftrhrs.claims.pinned-off: Claim borders: with the shovel or stick
aftrhrs.claims.hud.how.rect: Click a corner, then the opposite corner
aftrhrs.claims.hud.how.chunk: Click a block to claim its chunk
aftrhrs.claims.hud.how.circle: Click the center, walk out, click again
aftrhrs.claims.level.access: You can use doors and buttons
aftrhrs.claims.map.title: Claim Map
aftrhrs.claims.map.help: Click wilderness to claim · Shift + right-click yours to unclaim · Scroll to zoom
aftrhrs.pets.title: Pets
aftrhrs.pets.pat: Click to give a pat · drag to turn
aftrhrs.pets.release-sub: They go back to the wild for good.
aftrhrs.pets.stable.title: Stable · %s / %s stalls
aftrhrs.pets.stable.hint: Stabled pets rest safely and don't count toward your limit.
aftrhrs.places.title: Places
aftrhrs.places.none: No homes or warps yet. /sethome makes one!
aftrhrs.quests.title: ✦ Quests
aftrhrs.tpa.here: %s wants you to teleport to them
aftrhrs.hud.title: HUD & Display
aftrhrs.hud.el.compass.tip: The direction ribbon along the top, with your homes, warps, spawn and death point on it
aftrhrs.hud.el.quests.tip: Today's and this week's quests and the server goal (the tracker key flips it too)
aftrhrs.hud.el.quest_toast.tip: The little celebration when you finish a quest
aftrhrs.hud.el.pets.tip: Live 3D portraits of the pets that are out with you, with their health
aftrhrs.hud.el.land.tip: Whose land you're standing in (while holding the claim stick or with borders pinned)
aftrhrs.hud.el.claim_tool.tip: The golden shovel's mode, what your selection costs and your claim budget
aftrhrs.hud.el.banner.tip: The big title when you walk into someone's land or an admin area
aftrhrs.hud.el.claim_toast.tip: "Claimed" / "Unclaimed" with the blocks and chunks left
aftrhrs.hud.el.tpa.tip: Teleport and trade requests with the accept / deny keys. Switched off, the keys do nothing and you answer in chat
aftrhrs.hud.opt.compass-width.tip: How wide the compass ribbon is
aftrhrs.hud.opt.quest-rows.tip: How many open quests the sidebar lists
aftrhrs.hud.opt.pet-count.tip: How many of your pets get a portrait
aftrhrs.hud.opt.pet-layout.tip: Side by side, or stacked in a column
aftrhrs.hud.opt.beams.tip: Light beams over your places. Death points and graves are the ones you'll want most
aftrhrs.hud.opt.beam-labels.tip: Each beam's name and distance, readable through walls
aftrhrs.hud.opt.claim-walls.tip: The glowing walls around claims. Off hides claim borders entirely (the shovel's preview stays)
aftrhrs.hud.opt.claim-fx.tip: The rising wall, the sweep and the sparks when land is claimed or unclaimed
aftrhrs.hud.opt.claim-sounds.tip: The chime when your own claims change
aftrhrs.hud.reset-all.tip: Everything back to how it came: all pieces on, at home and at 100%
aftrhrs.hud.reset-all.confirm.tip: Click again within 3 seconds to reset every piece and option to its default
aftrhrs.hud.reset-one: Back to its usual place and size
aftrhrs.hud.label: %s · %s%%
aftrhrs.hud.help1: Drag to move · drag the corner or scroll to resize
aftrhrs.hud.help2: Right-click hides / shows · middle-click or R resets · arrows nudge · Tab picks the next piece · Esc when done
aftrhrs.hud.opt.updates.tip: Checks the Aftr Hrs releases on GitHub for new versions (with the GeckoLib and Fabric API they need). Updates are signed and checked before they are installed, and are put in place when you close the game.
aftrhrs.update.status.dev: Updates are off in development builds
aftrhrs.update.status.dev.tip: This copy of the mod isn't a jar, so it can't update itself.
aftrhrs.update.status.checking.tip: Asking GitHub for the newest release.
aftrhrs.update.status.available.tip: Install downloads it now; it goes in when you close the game.
aftrhrs.update.status.downloading.tip: The game keeps working while this downloads.
aftrhrs.update.status.ready: %s installs when you close the game
aftrhrs.update.status.ready.tip: Downloaded and checked. Restart now installs it and reopens the game where you are.
aftrhrs.update.toast.ready.body: Restart from the pause menu to use it: the game reopens by itself.
aftrhrs.update.restart.tip: Closes the game, installs the update and opens the game again, back where you are.
aftrhrs.update.toast.available.body: Install it from HUD & Display → Updates.
aftrhrs.hud.el.chatgame.tip: The chat game that is running: the question as chat shows it, the reward and the time left, then who won. You still answer in chat
aftrhrs.hud.opt.chatgame-sound.tip: A soft page turn when a chat game card appears (the chat chime plays either way)
aftrhrs.hud.sample.chatgame.name: Quick Math
aftrhrs.chatgame.title: Chat Game
aftrhrs.hud.el.wallet.tip: Your bank balance, with a short line for each change (a sale, stall rent, interest) and coins waiting for you at the bank
aftrhrs.hud.wallet.hide_amounts.tip: The coin purse shows ••• instead of numbers. Handy when streaming
aftrhrs.quiet.on: Quiet mode on: Aftr Hrs visuals hidden
aftrhrs.quiet.off: Quiet mode off: Aftr Hrs visuals back
aftrhrs.hud.opt.hide-fx-f1.tip: With the HUD hidden (F1), waypoint beams, their names and claim walls hide too, for clean screenshots. Claim walls stay while you hold the claim shovel or stick
aftrhrs.fish.title: Angler's Journal
aftrhrs.fish.empty: No fish on this server yet.
aftrhrs.fish.claim.tip: Every %s fish caught! Collect %s ⛃ to your bank balance.
aftrhrs.fish.records.title: Fish Records
aftrhrs.fish.records.empty: No records yet. Weigh a fish at a fish scale to set one.
aftrhrs.fish.records.how: Hold a fish and use a fish scale to weigh it. Bigger than the record? It's yours.
aftrhrs.fish.fight.title: Fish on!
aftrhrs.fish.fight.hint: Hold mouse, Space or Use to reel · %ss left · Esc gives up
aftrhrs.hud.el.inspect.tip: What a right-click would tell about the Arcana crop, crab pot or station under your crosshair
aftrhrs.hud.el.note.tip: The paper note beside your crosshair when you look at a smithing station
aftrhrs.hud.sample.inspect.title: Tomato
